name: Calliope
_notes: Steam-calliope / pipe-organ lead: harmonic FM, sustain, tiny air transient, and slow vibrato instead of the current generic dyad.
_notes_v2: Corrected spelling and turned the patch into a bright steam-organ/calliope voice using non-sine carriers, reed-like operator waveforms, light vibrato, and a tiny pitch scoop.

name: Celesta
_notes: Felt hammer plus bell bars: a fast 2/4-ratio chime, tiny high partial, and a faint sub-body.
_notes_v2: Soft bell-box celesta: mostly sine/triangle, a faint fixed high shimmer and fixed low wooden body to keep it distinct from glockenspiel.

name: Church Bell
_notes: Cathedral-size inharmonic bell with low body, wide beating, clapper transient, and long decaying partials.
_notes_v2: Large bell with fixed-ish hum/body partials, long operator releases, and wide unison panning.

name: Electric Piano
_notes: Tine bark + soft body: short bright 2:1 tine, low wooden body, tiny high hammer spark, mellow sustain.
_notes_v2: Tine EP with velocity-sensitive bark and proper amp tremolo target.

name: Gamelan
_notes: Legacy Gamelan tuning restored: bright metallic cross-FM with strong transient and long release.
_notes_v2: Restores the original embedded Gamelan preset values with neutral v2 extensions.

name: Glockenspiel
_notes: Tiny hard metal bars: brilliant, short high partial flash and clean ringing tail.
_notes_v2: Bright, hard, high metal bars with extremely fast pitch tick and fixed high sparkles.

name: Hand Drum
_notes: Skin hit: low thump, short noisy hand impact, and a quickly collapsing FM burst.
_notes_v2: A drum now behaves like a drum: low fixed resonances, non-harmonic burst, brown transient, and a strong downward pitch envelope.

name: Handpan
_notes: Warm handpan ding: softer transient, paired-body detune, singing partials, and a long mellow tail.
_notes_v2: Warm singing steel with paired beating and body resonance, less spiky than Gamelan.

name: Kalimba
_notes: Thumb piano tine plus wooden box: dry pluck, hollow body, and short inharmonic sparkle.
_notes_v2: Dry thumb-piano tine with box/body fixed resonances; shorter and woodier than Mbira.

name: Marimba
_notes: Warm wooden bar: hollow 4th-ish partial, darker resonator, and soft mallet noise.
_notes_v2: Dark hollow wood bar with resonator body, lower filter, and short woody pitch tick.

name: Mbira
_notes: Buzzing mbira: kalimba-like tine plus intentional rattle/feedback and wider sympathetic beating.
_notes_v2: Buzzy resonator mbira with saw/square rattle layer, clearly distinct from cleaner Kalimba.

name: Singing Bowl
_notes: Struck/rubbed bowl: slow-blooming inharmonic partials, wide stereo, and very long meditative decay.
_notes_v2: Slow overtone bloom: fixed partials, long releases, delayed modulation, and slow pan drift.

name: Soft Rhodes
_notes: Soft, dark Rhodes: less bark than Electric Piano, gentle tine, warm body, and small stereo drift.
_notes_v2: Mellow Rhodes: softer than Electric Piano, amp tremolo, tine responds to velocity, and carrier2 is no longer silent.

name: Spectral Shimmer
_notes: Wide evolving FM pad: staggered operator blooms, slow filter motion, and lush unison for Digitone/VST-style shimmer.
_notes_v2: Flagship ambient shimmer pad using stereo spread, delayed operators, fixed shimmer partials, and slow filter drift.

name: Tongue Drum
_notes: Soft steel tongue drum: round fundamental, gentle paired carrier, and mellow ringing partials.
_notes_v2: Clean, round steel tongue tone: less inharmonic than Handpan and much warmer than bells.

name: Vibraphone
_notes: Motor vibraphone: metal-bar attack, longer mellow sustain, and unmistakable pitch vibrato.
_notes_v2: Authentic motor vibraphone now uses amp tremolo instead of only pitch vibrato.

name: Xylophone
_notes: Hard wooden bars: sharp dry attack, short decay, little sustain, and darker tone than glockenspiel.
_notes_v2: Dry hard wooden bar: shorter and darker than Glockenspiel, more attack than Marimba.

name: Aurora FM Pad
_notes: Slow, warm, stereo FM pad with staggered operator bloom and filter drift.
_notes_v2: Updated to showcase Lead4opFM v2 fields: waveforms, fixed/key-tracked operators, velocity response, mod release, stereo spread, pitch envelope, and expanded LFO targets.

name: Glass Choir Pad
_notes: Airy choir-like FM pad: sub/formant body, gentle pitch movement, and glassy overtones.

name: Fixed Star Drone
_notes: Drone with fixed-frequency operators that stay like stars over changing notes; showcases fixedHz/keyTrack and very long modRelease.
_notes_v2: Drone with fixed-frequency operators that stay like stars over changing notes; showcases fixedHz/keyTrack and very long modRelease.

name: Amp Rotor Keys
_notes: Electric-key patch that demonstrates the new amp LFO target as a proper tremolo/rotor instead of pitch wobble.
_notes_v2: Electric-key patch that demonstrates the new amp LFO target as a proper tremolo/rotor instead of pitch wobble.

name: Brass FM Swell
_notes: A synthetic brass/reed swell enabled by saw carrier waveform, filter envelope, and delayed FM attack.
_notes_v2: A synthetic brass/reed swell enabled by saw carrier waveform, filter envelope, and delayed FM attack.

name: Frozen Formant Pad
_notes: A glassy formant pad with a bandpass filter and fixed operators; shows how FM can produce vocal-ish frozen spectra.
_notes_v2: A glassy formant pad with a bandpass filter and fixed operators; shows how FM can produce vocal-ish frozen spectra.

name: Plucked Ghost Harp
_notes: Plucked spectral harp showing strong velocity-to-index and pitch envelope for expressive attacks.
_notes_v2: Plucked spectral harp showing strong velocity-to-index and pitch envelope for expressive attacks.

name: Digital Waterphone
_notes: Uneasy bowed-metal/waterphone texture using inharmonic ratios, fixed rods, slow releases, and wide stereo drift.
